description:
Nihon Kizuna was the first music compilation from within Japan to raise money for victims of the March 11 Tohoku earthquake and tsunami. It raised over $30,000, which were donated to the Japan Red Cross as well as local non-profit organisations in the Fukushima region. 

Purchasing options have been removed from the original compilation. The bonus compilation remains available for free as it always was.

If you wish to support victims please donate directly and locally. If you have donated thank you!
credits:
All credits as per original release/production where applicable.
Additional mastering by XLII.
Thanks to all artists and labels for their kind donations.
